name: maestro
description: Maestro — poste de commandement self-hosted pour orchestrer des agents Claude Code

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @maestro/shared && npm run typecheck -w @maestro/server && npm run typecheck -w @maestro/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @maestro/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @maestro/server && npm run test -w @maestro/web
scripts.qa: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
